options.content: Jalaan Bani Bu Ali · STP · lab forms (Muscat days)  ·  thin lines: daily values  ·  light blue dashed: calendar-month average (sensor charts: 30-day average)  ·  shaded bands: warning and limit  ·  red dots: outside the limit

panels.description: Daily values (thin line), each calendar month's average (thick blue, months with at least 3 values), and values outside the limit (red dots). Limits as dashed lines with shaded bands.

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT l.time_of_sample_collection AS time, CASE WHEN lower(regexp_replace(btrim(l.location), '\s*:.*$', '')) = lower('Treated Wastewater') AND btrim(l.type_of_lab_test) = 'Ammonia Nitrogen' THEN 'Treated' END AS metric, l.result::numeric AS value FROM user_labtestdata l JOIN user_customform f ON f.id = l.form_id WHERE f.team_id = 16 AND ((lower(regexp_replace(btrim(l.location), '\s*:.*$', '')) = lower('Treated Wastewater') AND btrim(l.type_of_lab_test) = 'Ammonia Nitrogen')) AND $__timeFilter(l.time_of_sample_collection) AND l.time_of_sample_collection < now()) SELECT time, metric, value FROM s ORDER BY 1

WITH s AS (SELECT l.time_of_sample_collection AS time, CASE WHEN lower(regexp_replace(btrim(l.location), '\s*:.*$', '')) = lower('Treated Wastewater') AND btrim(l.type_of_lab_test) = 'Ammonia Nitrogen' THEN 'Treated' END AS metric, l.result::numeric AS value FROM user_labtestdata l JOIN user_customform f ON f.id = l.form_id WHERE f.team_id = 16 AND ((lower(regexp_replace(btrim(l.location), '\s*:.*$', '')) = lower('Treated Wastewater') AND btrim(l.type_of_lab_test) = 'Ammonia Nitrogen')) AND $__timeFilter(l.time_of_sample_collection) AND l.time_of_sample_collection < now()), m AS (SELECT time, value, date_trunc('month', time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Muscat') AS mo FROM s), a AS (SELECT mo, avg(value) AS av, count(*) AS n FROM m GROUP BY mo)
SELECT time, "Monthly average" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT m.time, a.av AS "Monthly average" FROM m JOIN a ON a.mo = m.mo WHERE a.n >= 3 UNION ALL SELECT a.mo AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Muscat', NULL::numeric FROM a WHERE a.mo AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Muscat' > $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) x ORDER BY time
